lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maato har ra(n)g maato ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am intoxicated, intoxicated with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦੀਓ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ॥ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ouhee peeo ouhee kheeo gurahi deeo daan keeo || uaahoo siu man raato ||1||
lines.translation: I drink it in - I am drunk with it. The Guru has given it to me in charity. My mind is drenched with it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ ਓੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ ਉਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥ ਮਨਿ ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ouhee bhaathee ouhee pochaa uhee piaaro uhee roochaa || man oho sukh jaato ||2||
lines.translation: It is my furnace, it is the cooling plaster. It is my love, it is my longing. My mind knows it as peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ ਖੇਲ ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਾਤੋ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj kel anad khel rahe pher bhae mel || naanak gur sabad paraato ||3||4||157||
lines.translation: I enjoy intuitive peace, and I play in bliss; the cycle of reincarnation is ended for me, and I am merged with the Lord. Nanak is pierced through with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||4||157||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੌੜੀ ਮਾਲਵਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee maalavaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Maalwaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੀਤਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਗੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam lehu meetaa lehu aagai bikham pa(n)th bhaiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Lord's Name; O my friend, chant it. Hereafter, the path is terrifying and treacherous. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevat sevat sadaa sev terai sa(n)g basat hai kaal ||
lines.translation: Serve, serve, forever serve the Lord. Death hangs over your head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਹੋ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar sevaa too(n) saadh kee ho kaateeai jam jaal ||1||
lines.translation: Do seva, selfless service, for the Holy Saints, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hom jag teerath keee bich haumai badhe bikaar ||
lines.translation: You may make burnt offerings, sacrificial feasts and pilgrimages to sacred shrines in egotism, but your corruption only increases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: narak surag dui bhu(n)chanaa hoi bahur bahur avataar ||2||
lines.translation: You are subject to both heaven and hell, and you are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: siv puree braham i(n)dr puree nihachal ko thaau naahi ||
lines.translation: The realm of Shiva, the realms of Brahma and Indra as well - no place anywhere is permanent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਹੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin har sevaa sukh nahee ho saakat aavahi jaahi ||3||
lines.translation: Without serving the Lord, there is no peace at all. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaiso gur upadesiaa mai taiso kahiaa pukaar ||
lines.translation: As the Guru has taught me, so have I spoken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai sun re manaa kar keeratan hoi udhaar ||4||1||158||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, people: sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and you shall be saved. ||4||1||158||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee maalaa₁ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaio baal budh sukh re ||
lines.translation: Adopting the innocent mind of a child, I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਹਾਨਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ ਚਿਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog haan mirat dookh sukh chit samasar gur mile ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Joy and sorrow, profit and loss, birth and death, pain and pleasure - they are all the same to my consciousness, since I met the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਚਉ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau lau hau kichh sochau chitavau tau lau dukhan bhare ||
lines.translation: As long as I plotted and planned things, I was full of frustration.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jau kripaal gur pooraa bhetiaa tau aanad sahaje ||1||
lines.translation: When I met the Kind, Perfect Guru, then I obtained bliss so easily. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਏ ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetee siaanap karam hau keee tete ba(n)dh pare ||
lines.translation: The more clever tricks I tried, the more bonds I was saddled with.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jau saadhoo kar masatak dhario tab ham mukat bhae ||2||
lines.translation: When the Holy Saint placed His Hand upon my forehead, then I was liberated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਰਤੋ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau lau mero mero karato tau lau bikh ghere ||
lines.translation: As long as I claimed, "Mine, mine!", I was surrounded by wickedness and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man tan budh arapee thaakur kau tab ham sahaj soe ||3||
lines.translation: But when I dedicated my mind, body and intellect to my Lord and Master, then I began to sleep in peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਈ ਚਲਿਅਉ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਡਾਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau lau pot uthaaee chaliau tau lau daan bhare ||
lines.translation: As long as I walked along, carrying the load, I continued to pay the fine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: pot daar gur pooraa miliaa tau naanak nirabhae ||4||1||159||
lines.translation: But I threw away that bundle, when I met the Perfect Guru; O Nanak, then I became fearless. ||4||1||159||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਰੀ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaavan tiaagio ree tiaagio ||
lines.translation: I have renounced my desires; I have renounced them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiaagio mai gur mil tiaagio ||
lines.translation: I have renounced them; meeting the Guru, I have renounced them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਮਾਨਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਆਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukh aana(n)d ma(n)gal ras maan gobi(n)dai aagio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: All peace, joy, happiness and pleasures have come since I surrendered to the Will of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
